p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product quality, start-up business, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules often change: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens up updated official sources, and then you read them in your own language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Help Desk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): Taxes, duties, regulations, procedures for a product and a country on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): Customs Duties and Rules of Origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: Eping (WTO): Standards, labelling, health regulations for products in this country
p.espaces.rg_e1: Trade with the European Union, from the European Union.
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs Code and Duties on Entry into the European Union
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a Business, Taxes, International Trade, Through the Country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): Check that a platform has not been flagged by a regulator, before trusting money
p.espaces.rg_note: Opening a site in its own language: Use your browser's translation, or use "Understand a document" for a document. For a major decision, ask a professional in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, incoterms, free official equipment, forwarders, carriers.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Responsibilities and Rules for Nearly All Countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access 2 Markets (EU): Duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs Code (HS Code) to be applied upon entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport documents: Bill of Lading (Sea), Airway Bill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (for businesses importing or exporting to the European Union)
p.espaces.cu_d6: According to the product: Sanitary or Phytosanitary Certificate, License, CE Standard
p.espaces.cu_i1: The buyer from the seller's factory handles everything.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the export-cleared goods to the buyer's vehicle.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; afterwards, risks and costs are on the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller provides freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: All including import duty must be paid by the seller.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Everywhere prohibited or regulated: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected plants (CITS), certain drugs. Such lists can be rejected and reported (RD).
p.espaces.cu_src: Source: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact regulations for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Visa, Remittili… Compare the rates for your country before you send money.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself, does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, and send with your chosen service.
p.espaces.mt_wb: According to the World Bank report, remittance rates vary across the world.

p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total amount you get: fee + exchange rate. The hidden cost is a rate worse than the market rate.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Select the way the person should receive the money, whether it is in Currency, Bank Account or Mobile Wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN).
p.espaces.mt_k3: Sometimes an ID document is required to send and receive.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Don’t send money to someone you meet online, or send money to “unlock” a gift, package, loan, visa: it’s almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices are changing: always check their website when you send.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: Find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product. The supplier delivers it directly to your customer. It's easy to get started, but you take responsibility for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is permitted in your customers' country: no counterfeit products, no unauthorized products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (see "Seller/Supplier" lists here or on trading platforms) and order a sample before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the actual price: product, shipping, customs duties, taxes in the customer's country, payment fees, refund.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business for business status, GST and taxes (see Trade Laws) according to your country.
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right to return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants to pay in full by bank transfer, crypto currency or in an unsecured manner.
p.espaces.ds_w2: The paid courses that promise to make you rich.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from outside Europe is subject to VAT from the first euro.
